title: contribution: check PR is done on develop
body:
We should ensure that our PRS follows this:
- [ ] pull request is done on develop

Travis is providing the targeted branch in env variable "TRAVIS_BRANCH" when in a PR.

comments.body: Number of times this led to a "bad" merge: 1 (increment me)

What about adding checks on the jsdoc as well? Checking that we have jsdoc on all our widgets and that it matches the arguments. I think ESLint have rules for that through a plugin, or maybe try [jsdoced](https://github.com/jeromeetienne/jsdoced.js)

> I think ESLint have rules for that through a plugin

Yes we could start with an ESLINT check
